5. The bottom gray bar gained 1 pixel (579 -> 580)
So clicking on the blue shape on the right caused:
- The white frame around it to disappear
- The blue 4x4 and the scattered blue pattern on the left to SWAP positions
This is a swap mechanic! Clicking on a right-side target swaps the corresponding colored object on the left with another object.
Wait, let me think more carefully. The blue 4x4 was at (20,18) and the scattered pattern was at (34-37, 8-11). After clicking the right blue shape:
- The scattered pattern moved to (20,18) area (where the blue 4x4 was)
- A solid blue 4x4 appeared at (34,8) (where the scattered pattern was)
So clicking the right blue target swapped the blue 4x4 with the scattered pattern.
But wait - the scattered pattern had blue and charcoal dots. After the swap, it's now a solid blue 4x4. That means the scattered pattern was actually a "scrambled" version of the blue 4x4.
So the mechanic seems to be: clicking on a right-side target "solves" or "assembles" the corresponding color on the left, swapping a scrambled piece with a solved piece.
The white frames disappearing is significant - it means those targets are now "completed".
Let me now click on the red target on the right to see if it does something similar.
